**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

§ 22 is the document's only audit right binding us, and it already meets every preferred element:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Once per 12 months | § 22.1 "no more than once in any twelve-month period" |
| 30 days' written notice | § 22.1 "at least thirty days' prior written notice" |
| Business hours | § 22.1 "during normal business hours" |
| Independent auditor | § 22.1 "an independent auditor" |
| Auditor confidentiality | § 22.1 "bound by confidentiality" |
| Off-site where possible | § 22.1 "off-site where practicable" |
| Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment | § 22.2 |
| No direct system access | § 22.2 "may not access Customer systems directly" |

§ 22.3 goes further in our favour (audit findings are our Confidential Information, usable only to enforce the Agreement). No redline proposed.
